metadata.purpose: Second-iteration player performance data collection and weighting config

source_priority.reason: Key-based provider with searchable player endpoints and player statistics includes.
Key-based provider with player profile/statistics endpoints and season-contextual player ratings.
Rich per-player season fields once player IDs are found through league-player season endpoints.
Free public competition/player tables for appearances, goals, assists, cards, starts, penalties, fantasy points, and goalkeeper clean sheets.
Useful when accessible, but direct automated access has returned 403 Forbidden in this project.

derived_scores.recent_form_score: Weighted by match recency with half-life decay.
derived_scores.knockout_score: Weighted average of knockout-stage performances where available.
derived_scores.attacking_score: Position-sensitive blend of goals, shots, xG-like proxies, and dribbling.
derived_scores.creation_score: Position-sensitive blend of assists, key passes, and big chances created.
derived_scores.defensive_score: Position-sensitive blend of tackles, interceptions, clearances, blocks, and duels.
derived_scores.goalkeeper_score: Blend of rating, saves, clean sheets, penalties saved, and goals prevented where available.
